name: Coffin of the Ornate Sediment Lord

pages.text: Coffin of the Ornate Sediment Lord: seals and revives a Sediment Lord of your own.

The way the Sediment Lord appears cannot help but remind you of another "lord" in the Overworld, and you cannot help wondering whether a similar method could summon the Sediment Lord to serve you. After a little thought you designed this ornate coffin: a single Totem of Undying is all it takes to summon your Sediment Lord.
It can revive even after death! Now that is a true lord!
